texts.li: [colony:Merciful] The colony has a name for second chances. Now it has to decide whether that stretches to {SECRET}. People are polite to {A_nameDef}'s face and careful behind {A_possessive} back.

[colony:Harsh] This colony doesn't forgive easily, and now it knows about {A_nameDef} ({SECRET}). A few people want {A_nameDef} gone. Others point out that {A_nameDef} has stood on the wall with them through every raid.\n\nThe council has to settle it before someone else does.

[winter] Shut in by the snow, the colony can't get away from what it now knows about {A_nameDef} ({SECRET}), or from {A_nameDef}. Meals are tense, and a few people have started keeping a weapon by the bed.

[lowtech] A rider came to the gate this morning with a sealed letter and a description of {A_nameDef} that was very accurate. Someone has heard what the colony now knows ({SECRET}), and there's a price on {A_nameDef}'s head.\n\nThe bounty hunters ask only to be told when {A_nameDef} next leaves the walls alone, and will pay well for it.

[colony:Guarded] Even a colony that keeps its gate shut can't keep out news. Bounty hunters have heard about {A_nameDef} ({SECRET}), and have sent word that they'll pay for the hour {A_nameDef} next goes out alone.\n\n{A_nameDef} has heard about the offer, and is waiting to hear the council's answer.
[office:Physician] {A_nameDef} still holds the physician's chair on the council, but since word got out about {SECRET}, most of the colony would rather bleed than be treated by {A_objective}.

[afterraid] Since it came out ({SECRET}), two of the wounded from the last fight have refused to let {A_nameDef} near them. One of them is bleeding through the bandage as it is.\n\nSomeone has to decide who does the stitching, and quickly.
[b:trait:Abrasive] {B_nameDef} has made a running joke of {A_nameDef} and {SECRET}, and tells it at every meal with {A_nameDef} sitting right there. {A_nameDef} has had enough.

[winter] There's little to talk about in the long winter evenings, so {B_nameDef} talks about {A_nameDef}. The secret ({SECRET}) has been told and retold by the stove until it barely resembles the truth.\n\n{A_nameDef} wants the council to end it.

[lowtech] Someone stuck a knife in the gate before dawn, with a note pinned under it.

"{A_nameDef} owes us 400 silver. Send it with the next caravan, or we collect another way."

{A_nameDef} recognized the knife, and hasn't been past the gate since.

[trait:Kind] It's out ({SECRET}), and {A_nameDef}, who would rather do a kindness than be thanked for one, has been hiding in the workshop ever since. The colony wants to thank {A_objective} properly anyway.

[winter] Someone chalked a heart on {A_nameDef}'s door during the night, and {A_nameDef} scrubbed it off before breakfast, with frost on the step. Since it came out ({SECRET}), the colony has wanted to do something, and can't agree what.

[winter] The coughing season has come, and the colony now knows about {A_nameDef} ({SECRET}). Every cough at supper gets a look toward {A_nameDef}.\n\n{B_nameDef} wants to examine every one of them before the looks turn into more than looks. Others want {A_nameDef} moved somewhere apart.
[b:past:healer] {B_nameDef} has seen real sickness, rooms full of it, and doesn't think there's much to fear from {A_nameDef} ({SECRET}). Not everyone is willing to take {B_nameDef}'s word for it.

[b:trait:Brawler] {B_nameDef} has wanted to test {A_nameDef} since the day the colony found out about the pits. Today {B_nameDef} threw down a challenge in the yard, loudly, and won't take no for an answer.\n\n{A_nameDef} has asked the council to end it one way or the other.

[winter] The truth is out ({SECRET}), and the winter isn't making it any easier. {A_nameDef} paces the halls at night, and the medicine shelf has a lock on it that wasn't there before.\n\n{B_nameDef} has offered to sit with {A_nameDef} through the worst of it.
[colony:Open] The colony prides itself on not keeping secrets, and now it's choking on one ({SECRET}). People talk about {A_nameDef} in corners, and {A_nameDef} knows it.

[skill:Crafting] Every hinge in the colony has been taken apart by {A_nameDef} at least once, and most of them put back. Now that {A_nameDef} has come of age, {B_nameDef}, who runs the workshop, wants {A_objective} at the bench.
[lowtech] {A_nameDef} is grown, and {B_nameDef} wants {A_objective} at the forge and the bench, learning the trade the old way: sweeping first, then holding, then making.
[skill:Medicine] {A_nameDef} has come of age, and has been bandaging dolls, dogs and anyone who would hold still for years. {B_nameDef}, the colony's healer, wants to teach {A_objective} properly.
[afterraid] {A_nameDef} came of age the same week as the last raid, and spent it carrying water to the wounded. {B_nameDef} noticed, and wants {A_nameDef} as an apprentice in the infirmary.
[skill:Intellectual] {A_nameDef} has come of age and has already read everything in the colony twice. {B_nameDef} wants {A_objective} at the research bench, where the questions are harder.

[afterraid] {A_nameDef} came of age in the middle of a raid, watching from a window. Now {A_nameDef} wants a place on the wall, and {B_nameDef}, the colony's best shot, has offered to teach.\n\nSome of the older colonists would rather keep {A_objective} behind that window a while longer.

[skill:Shooting] {A_nameDef} has been hitting the fence posts with stones from across the yard since {A_pronoun} was small. Now that {A_nameDef} is grown, {B_nameDef} wants to put a real weapon in {A_possessive} hands and train {A_objective} for the wall.

[b:trait:Gourmand] {B_nameDef} spent the afternoon on a stew, the good kind, with the last of the spices. {PET_nameDef}, {A_nameDef}'s animal, ate it while {B_nameDef} was looking for a spoon.\n\n{B_nameDef} has brought the empty pot to the council. {A_nameDef} says it was a compliment.

[winter] {PET_nameDef} has discovered that the kitchen is the warmest room in the colony, and won't leave it. {B_nameDef}, who cooks there, has found fur in the bread twice this week, and wants the animal out.\n\n{A_nameDef}, whose animal it is, says it's too cold to put {PET_objective} anywhere else.
